Owed.description:
An obligation a change leaves owed. A plan written before the rename
names its path `control`.

control.description:
The path of the obligation left owed. Board's check does not follow
it, because an obligation is deleted once its work is done and a plan
snapshot never changes. `changes.plan` and the migration check that
the path holds a rule when they write it.

rule.description:
The path of the obligation left owed. Board's check does not follow
it, because an obligation is deleted once its work is done and a plan
snapshot never changes. `changes.plan` and the migration check that
the path holds a rule when they write it.

why.description: Why this change does not discharge it, and what will.

description:
`changes/amendment/v1`: what one `changes.plan-amend` added to a plan.

It lives at `/changes/<name>/amendments/<stamp>`, with the stamp of the
plan it wrote. Each field it adds to is left out when it added none.

from.description: The plan version it added to.

owed.description: The obligations it added to the plan's owed entries.

paths.description: The files and SQLite GLOB patterns it added to the plan's paths.

plan.description: The plan version the amendment wrote.

sections.description: The test headings it filled in the plan's text.

items.description:
A heading of a plan's text that an amendment may fill, which the land
gate's `test-sections` check reads.
enum: What the tests do not prove

title: AmendmentRecord
